def settings(keys: list[str], values: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    """Overlay keys[i] = values[i] on the defaults mode=fast and level=3.

    The result holds the value of mode, then the value of level, then the
    values of all other keys in the order they first appear in keys. If a
    key repeats, its last value wins.
    """
    pre keys.len() == values.len()
    post out.len() >= 2
    ex settings(keys=[], values=[]) == ["fast", "3"]
    ex settings(keys=["level", "x"], values=["5", "y"]) == ["fast", "5", "y"]
    ex settings(keys=["x", "mode", "x"], values=["a", "slow", "b"]) == ["slow", "3", "b"]
    vals: dict[str, str] = {"mode": "fast", "level": "3"}
    order: list[str] = []
    for i in range(keys.len()):
        k = keys[i]
        if k not in vals:
            order.append(k.copy())
        vals[k.copy()] = values[i].copy()
    out: list[str] = [vals["mode"].copy(), vals["level"].copy()]
    for k in order:
        out.append(vals[k].copy())
    return out
